publication_verdict.recommended_public_framing: stable intermediate baseline with bounded support/frontier packets
forbidden_framings: quantitative prediction without reproducible protocol/code/data/output hash/falsifier
publication_verdict.reason: All science blockers are terminal; owner/toolchain gates still control actual publication.

release_policy.release_unit: no-send staging baseline plus bounded support/frontier packets until science terminality passes
release_policy.not_a_release_unit: raw private feedback, raw model transcripts, unadjudicated theorem promotion, unsupported prediction wording
release_policy.claim_promotion_rule: support/frontier packets may create obligations, demotions and replay requirements; they cannot promote canonical claims without proof/evidence gates
release_policy.why_1_3_2_is_built_this_way: It preserves the current stable OC Core baseline while exposing reviewed frontier material as bounded, no-send support, but external publication is blocked until all 82 science gaps are terminal.

science_inclusion_rows.release_treatment: bounded external-criticism research packet and reviewer acknowledgement without endorsement
science_inclusion_rows.claim_effect: claim ceilings and proof obligations preserved
domain lines are support/frontier material unless replay gates close

science_backlog_rows.scientific_meaning: The canonical metamodel still has reopenable seams: interface, level, domain and translation joints must be terminalized or explicitly demoted.
science_backlog_rows.why_not_closed: Current evidence marks the active executor as grouped seam repair, not completed theorem/proof closure.
science_backlog_rows.closure_requirement: Terminalize each seam by proof, counterexample, claim demotion, replay evidence, or explicit release-visible obligation.
science_backlog_rows.release_effect: Does not block 1.3.2 as a baseline; blocks claims that OC is TOE-complete or final.

science_backlog_rows.scientific_meaning: Root claim families remain under proof/refutation work, including K0 substrate and K9 theory-construction obligations.
science_backlog_rows.why_not_closed: They are in progress and cannot be treated as terminal root claims without further proof.
science_backlog_rows.closure_requirement: Provide bounded proof support or demote the affected root claim ceiling.
science_backlog_rows.release_effect: 1.3.2 may publish the current core only as bounded ontology, not as completed TOE proof.

science_backlog_rows.scientific_meaning: The proof/refutation discipline itself has an open family, so theorem fate and refutation bookkeeping remain active.
science_backlog_rows.why_not_closed: Unsupported theorem labels must remain conjectures or proof obligations.
science_backlog_rows.closure_requirement: Close the proof/refutation discipline gap with a verified theorem-fate ledger and red-team counterexample pass.

science_backlog_rows.scientific_meaning: Some empirical/domain bridge rows still need replay protocols or domain-specific evidence.
science_backlog_rows.why_not_closed: Quantitative and prediction wording is not allowed without protocol, code, data or fixture, output hash and falsifier.
science_backlog_rows.closure_requirement: Run or specify reproducible replay protocols, or keep the claim at structural/operator-signature level.
science_backlog_rows.release_effect: Domain packets remain bounded support/frontier material.

science_backlog_rows.scientific_meaning: Publication/external-review closure is not terminal until owner review and final public wording are approved.
science_backlog_rows.why_not_closed: No outbound publication, DOI minting or submission is currently authorized.
science_backlog_rows.closure_requirement: Owner-approved publication wording, release tag/upload plan and post-release verification.

science_backlog_rows.scientific_meaning: Market/value externalization remains science-locked until release and claim boundaries are stable.
science_backlog_rows.why_not_closed: External value actions must not outrun scientific and publication governance.
science_backlog_rows.closure_requirement: Owner-approved no-send review pack and separate release/publication unlock.
science_backlog_rows.release_effect: No revenue/client/outbound action is part of this release preparation.
